Chess Wrapped (Lichess API)

An interactive retrospective tool for chess players built on top of the public Lichess API. Ingests player PGN game histories to evaluate opening efficiency (win rates across Sicilian, Caro-Kann, Queen's Gambit, etc.), tactical time scrambles, and blunder hotspots across different time controls.

Python Lichess API PGN Parsing Data Visualization
Machine Learning & Sports Analytics Active Project

AI Fantasy Premier League Assistant

An analytical decision-support system designed to solve the weekly Fantasy Premier League transfer dilemma. Integrates underlying expected metrics (xG, xA, big chances created) with fixture difficulty ratings and squad value constraints to compute optimal rotation paths over a 5-gameweek horizon.
